messages.content: 在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？

message.content:
在大多數傳統撲克遊戲（例如德州撲克、奧馬哈等）中，每位玩家在發牌階段會獲得相同數量的私人手牌（通常是兩張）。之後，莊家會把公共牌（翻牌、轉牌、河牌）一次性發給所有玩家，這些牌對每個玩家都是可見且共享的。由於每位玩家都收到相同數量的私人手牌，而公共牌又是共用的，因此沒有任何一名玩家在手牌上「擁有」比其他人更多的卡片。

如果你指的是「誰持有整副牌」或「誰掌握了發牌權」，那麼答案是莊家：在每一輪發牌時，莊家負責從牌堆中抽取並分配牌，並在整局遊戲結束前保留整副牌（除非進行洗牌或重新分配）。但就「手牌數量」而言，所有玩家在任何時刻都持有相同數量的卡片。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？" which translates to "In a poker game, who has the most cards?" They want to know who holds the most cards. In standard poker games like Texas Hold'em, each player gets two private cards (hole cards). But the dealer deals community cards to all players. So no one has more than others. However, if we consider the dealer or the pot? The question might be ambiguous. We can interpret as "who has the most cards in their hand?" In Texas Hold'em, each player has two cards. But the dealer deals community cards to all players. So no one has more. But maybe the dealer has the most because they hold the deck? Or the dealer has the most because they have the entire deck? But the question likely expects an answer: "In a standard poker game, each player receives the same number of cards, so no one has more." Or "In Texas Hold'em, each player has two cards; the dealer deals community cards to all players." So answer accordingly.
